## Evidence at a glance {#sec-evidence .unnumbered}

This table is planned and has not been implemented. It will show one row per outcome, with the median assigned-arm difference, inner 50% and outer 89% credible intervals, probability of benefit, probability of exceeding the stated practical threshold, and release status.

The table must read the fitted summaries and the full publication decision. The draft helper in `_report_data.qmd` checks convergence and unreadable files only; it does not yet apply all input, artefact and robustness requirements. Until that connection is complete, this chapter displays no fitted estimates.

The crossover-model t2 contrast uses the same randomised trial. Agreement with the single-outcome available-case modified ITT estimate checks sensitivity to the model specification; it is not independent replication. Evidence labels describe the probability of a named claim, not the size or causal status of an effect.
